observed: Type/Skeleton were read from an explicit Style target in legacy/Promo, and an implicit root binding in Slot. Current target semantic projection processes the property globally and requires explicit targetId for the selected binding. Slot projection therefore became UNKNOWN.
cause: Mixed explicit target and implicit root bindings in one semantic API property.
correction: Use explicit target.root for Slot Type/Skeleton bindings; preserve explicit target.surface in legacy/Promo. No core changes.
